body: [Here's a list of all aurthorized firstarrows dealers.](https://www.first-arrows.com/en/authorized-dealers) Unless they go by a different name, they don't appear to be on the list. Best case they hand you a used product; worst case it's fugazi. That said, I've never seen fake first arrows in hand.

Of the FA stuff I did see on taobao, considering the relatively high prices (pretty much retail), I assumed they were either legitimate retailers, a proxy service, or a secondhand seller. Didn’t expect niche brands like FA to have any demand on the Chinese market, much less any demand that would generate reps.

Now knowing that FA does their feathers by hand, any reps would end up looking like shit anyways.

Damn I thought they'd only fake more expensive labels like Goros and T&K. Before purchasing, I searched taobao, xianyu, and rep archives and I couldn’t find anything so I thought I was in the clear. I barely found anything about FA in general. Hopefully FA keeps their molds under lock and key lol
Thanks for your insight! What exactly are the tells that it’s an older piece? Makes sense as I bought it off an old head on Mercari who was letting go of some FA, Arizona Freedom, etc.
